Work closely with users and business units to identify business/operational pain points, elicit and analyse requirements, investigate and assess business/operating procedures, and collaborate with the team to provide solutions

Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Relevate is a Brisbane-based operations, strategy and technology consulting firm that helps businesses unlock the full value of their software. We work across CRM implementation, IT managed services, virtual staffing and digital transformation advisory, with particular depth in the Zoho ecosystem. Plenty of firms can install software; our real point of difference is adoption. We make sure the people using the tools genuinely embrace them, because that is where return on investment is actually realised. Our work is practical and outcome-driven. We have helped clients cut integration costs, reduce monthly licensing spend and reclaim days of manual reporting time each month simply by rethinking how their systems fit together. In short, we help teams work smarter rather than harder, so our clients become more profitable, more valuable and more resilient.

ICT Customer Support Officer | Relevate — Brisbane, QLD

Key Responsibilities
•	Serve as a first point of contact for clients experiencing issues with their CRM, business applications or supporting hardware, diagnosing problems and delivering timely resolutions
•	Assess client needs and recommend suitable software, hardware and system configurations to resolve operational challenges and close value gaps in their business tools
•	Customise and adapt existing applications, including Zoho Creator apps, CRM workflows and automations, so they align with each client's specific processes
•	Install, configure and deploy Zoho modules and other business software across client environments, ensuring each solution is set up correctly for the way the client works
•	Support and drive effective adoption of implemented systems by training end users and monitoring usage, so applications and equipment are used efficiently and deliver maximum value
•	Assist with implementing client networks and integrations between platforms, including connecting systems through tools such as Zoho Flow, and support the build and ongoing upkeep of client web portals and websites
•	Troubleshoot, repair or arrange replacement of peripheral equipment such as printers, modems and workstations as part of our managed services support
•	Assemble, install, maintain and repair computer hardware, software and related equipment as required, keeping client systems reliable with minimal disruption
•	Log, track and prioritise support requests, maintaining accurate records of issues and resolutions
•	Document configurations, fixes and processes to build and maintain an internal knowledge base
•	Escalate complex or unresolved matters to senior consultants and collaborate with the wider team to deliver solutions
•	Provide both remote and on-site support to clients as needed, and assist virtual staffing team members with the tools and systems they rely on

Skills, Qualifications and Experience
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field
•	At least 1 year of experience in an ICT support or similar customer-facing technical role

Personal Attributes
•	Genuinely customer-focused, with a patient and approachable manner
•	Well organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
•	Comfortable working both independently and as part of a close-knit team
•	Keen to keep learning and to stay across new technologies and platforms

Hours and Remuneration
This is a full-time position of approximately 38 hours per week. We are offering a salary of $75,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation per annum for the successful applicant.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping people and working with modern business technology, we would love to hear from you.

About us

We’re not like other digital marketing companies.

We are a consulting-led agency. What does that mean? It means our sole focus is driving profitable growth for our client’s business.
It means we are platform and channel-agnostic. We look at where clients want to go and tell them the best way to get there, even if that means taking a road less travelled.

We work with some of the world’s best-known companies, including innovative scale-ups, large global brands and private equity firms, to deliver visionary yet pragmatic solutions to their unique challenges.

We (and our clients!) consider us experts in: media buying & advertising, creative, SEO, social media management, content, web analytics & attribution, website development, conversion rate optimization and UX/ UI consulting. We use our expertise and skills to help our clients drive fast profitable growth for their business.

We service clients in Australia and the US with most of us based in our Sydney office and some key team members working remotely around the world. We are currently operating on a hybrid model with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office.

Our company culture is one of innovation, diversity and excellence. Most importantly, we genuinely care about each other, which makes working at Orange Line that much better!


About the role

Reporting to the Paid Media Manager, the Senior Paid Media Executive will help look after
our high-growth client portfolio.

You will specifically be involved in delivering cutting-edge strategies across a spectrum of
paid channels such as Search, Social, Programmatic, Lead Generation & Mobile, with a focus
on optimising results. Reporting will also be a big part of the role, so numbers shouldn’t faze
you.

This is the perfect opportunity if you’re looking to gain hands-on experience in digital
marketing whilst working with prestigious clients, and essentially broaden your skillset and
learn the execution of new channels.

You will be responsible for

- Management of digital campaigns including setup, reporting & optimisation
- Support managers at client weekly meetings and present key learnings and action items
- Management of existing accounts & campaigns, with best practice application, budget management, reconciliation and testing
- Delivery of campaign reporting with the support of our reporting specialists
- Provide insight, analysis and guidance to client and team on campaign optimisation and opportunities
- Use of 3rd party tools including Bid Management platforms and Ad Servers
- Create media plans and provide spend forecasts
- Liaise with 3rd party providers to resolve any issues as they arise
- Proactively contribute to team meetings & knowledge sharing


About you

- 3+ years’ experience in Paid Search or Paid Social is crucial
- Experience across other paid channels is desired but not essential
- Reporting / analytical - comfortable with numbers and data
- Strong skill set across Microsoft Excel
- Experience working on performance-focused clients is desired but not essential
- Confidence & proven results in implementing optimisations to drive the desired outcome
- Clear communicator and innovative thinker
- Commitment to staying ahead of industry trends & an eagerness to learn
- Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving
- Effective and efficient working style
- Take pride in your work and care about the people around you because we are a family-oriented agency


What's in it for you

- Awesome office located 15 minutes walk to/from Central Station
- Orange Line is a company that believes in work/life harmony and flexibility
- Permanent hybrid model with Mon/Wed/Fri working from home and Tue/Thu in the office
- You will receive excellent avenues for learning & development. We set clear goals and milestones: so when we grow, you grow.
- You will work with a mix of brands and industries here in Australia and internationally
- Work alongside subject-matter experts who've been working at that level for years, giving you breadth of knowledge and experience
- Monthly organised social events, like brewery tours, boat parties, cheese making - and maybe you can suggest the next one!
- We are super inclusive and are open to everyone and everything. Have a say in the team, the culture, and the agency as a whole

## ICT Customer Support Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Customer Support Officer to join our team and deliver high-quality technical assistance to end users across the organisation. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues, supporting the deployment and maintenance of computer infrastructure, and ensuring staff can make effective use of technology in their day-to-day work. You will bring strong communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving and is committed to delivering outstanding service.
## Key Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and equipment inventory using ticketing and asset management systems
